title: Vegan Pappardelle with Garlic Confit and Parmesan
subtitle: with rocket and toasted almonds
description: Fresh homemade durum wheat pappardelle tossed in garlic and shallot confit oil with parsley, toasted almonds and rocket, topped with a cashew and nutritional yeast vegan Parmesan.

steps.text: Mix the flour and salt in a mixer with a dough hook for about 10 minutes, gradually adding the water until a smooth dough forms. Stop the mixer now and then to gather the mixture from the sides by hand. Wrap in cling film and rest for 1 hour. Roll the dough with a pasta machine to 1 mm thick and cut into 2 cm wide ribbons.
Place the shallots and garlic in a deep pot, pour over the olive oil and cook over very low heat until soft and the oil has absorbed all the flavours.
Make the vegan Parmesan by processing the cashews, nutritional yeast, pine nuts and 1/2 tsp salt in a food processor until a uniform, paste-like mixture forms.
Boil the pasta in a pot of salted water for about 2 minutes until al dente.

Transfer a few spoonfuls of the confit oil to a frying pan and add a little ground chilli. Keep the oil from boiling, add the pasta and season with salt, pepper and parsley. Scatter with almonds and remove from the heat.
Transfer the pasta to a serving plate, top with fresh rocket, drizzle with olive oil and scatter the vegan Parmesan over.
